messages:
Rowan: corpcard declined when buying a last-minute conference "power pass" for our booth; vendor threatened to release the slot so I paid with personal Visa ending 4321. Attached vendor_receipt.pdf ($350). @Sam can you approve reimbursement?
Priya - Finance: Sorry about that. Please submit to Concur with the receipt and vendor invoice if available. Add note: 'corpcard declined; personal card used; potential post to corpcard descriptor CONF-SERV'. Manager approval required.
Sam - Manager: Approved. Please proceed, Rowan.
Rowan: Submitted Concur EXP-2026-0902-4412 with receipt and invoice. Note added about CONF-SERV descriptor.
CardOpsBot: Created ticket CORP-CARD-11999 to trace merchant descriptor CONF-SERV. CardOps: please include any processor trace IDs from the vendor.
Priya - Finance: We'll process this as an OOP exception for now and queue for expedited reimbursement. If CardOps later confirms the corpcard charge posted for the same TXN we'll reconcile and reverse the OOP payment. Tag expense with code EVENT_SPONSOR. Expect payment in ~3-5 business days.
ExpenseBot: Expense EXP-2026-0902-4412 submitted by Rowan at 2026-09-02 17:14 UTC. Status: awaiting finance processing.
Rowan: FYI vendor said CONF-SERV sometimes batches multiple event items under one descriptor; I attached their email.
Priya - Finance: Good context. CardOps will report back; if you see any post on the company card upload a screenshot here. We'll close this thread once reimbursement issued or reconciliation complete. :thumbsup:
